env.CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_AGENT_TEAMS: gives the CC model agent-team tools; OC has no counterpart
env.CLAUDE_AUTOCOMPACT_PCT_OVERRIDE: changes when CC compacts; OC compaction settings are not mapped faithfully
env.ENABLE_LSP_TOOL: enables CC's model-callable LSP tool; OC's lsp tool is gated by OPENCODE_EXPERIMENTAL_LSP_TOOL, which the adapter does not set
env.ENABLE_LSP_TOOLS: enables CC's model-callable LSP tools; OC's lsp tool is gated by OPENCODE_EXPERIMENTAL_LSP_TOOL, which the adapter does not set

settings.autoCompactWindow: changes CC's compaction window; not mapped to OC compaction settings
settings.effortLevel: CC reasoning effort; maps to OC agent variant but unverified against 1.19.0, so OC runs at its default effort
settings.modelSettings: per-model CC effort/context settings; not mapped, OC runs at its default

claudeJson.claudeAiMcpEverConnected: claude.ai connector MCP servers are not available in OC
